CustomField.description: dibuat untuk kebutuhan report mtd revenue agar apple to apple actual -target
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Group_Type__c, 'Target'),IF(MONTH(Date__c) = MONTH(TODAY()), IF( ISPICKVAL(Group_Type__c, 'Target'),Amount__c / Number_of_Day__c * day(today()),0), IF(MONTH(Date__c) < MONTH(TODAY()),Amount__c , 0)),null)
CustomField.label: MTD YTD Target
